body: The pair is streaked with clouded sample jar from treated rows. It was set aside after the flies vanished, before anyone marked the cab unsafe.
title: Clouded sample jar by the cab

body: The kit is unopened. The water bottle has a black line drawn halfway down it and the same line repeated on the charred wall. Whoever marked it was measuring what survived the fire, not treating a burn.
title: A waterline after the fire
